name: fim-autocomplete
author: Dennis Kruyt
description: Standalone inline code autocomplete (fill-in-the-middle) for any LLM provider.

enumDescriptions: LM Studio. Local models via an OpenAI-compatible server.
Self-hosted vLLM server. Native FIM endpoint.
Local Lemonade server with NPU/GPU acceleration.
Mistral. Codestral is purpose-built for FIM. Native FIM endpoint.
DeepSeek. deepseek-coder has a native FIM endpoint.
Inception. Mercury Coder, a diffusion code model. Native FIM endpoint.
SiliconFlow. Hosted open models. Native FIM endpoint.
OpenAI, or any gateway speaking the OpenAI API - set apiBase. Native FIM endpoint.
Hugging Face Text Embeddings Inference. Embeddings only.
fim.provider.markdownDescription:
Which LLM provider serves completions. Providers whose description says *Native FIM endpoint* have a real fill-in-the-middle API; the rest are prompted with the FIM template for the model and usually do worse.

Set `#fim.model#` to go with it.

fim.model.markdownDescription:
Model name, exactly as `#fim.provider#` expects it - e.g. `qwen2.5-coder:1.5b`, `codestral-latest`, `deepseek-coder`.

Autocomplete works best with a fill-in-the-middle code model. Run **FIM: Select Model** from the command palette to pick from the models your provider reports.

fim.apiBase.markdownDescription: Base URL of the API. Required for self-hosted providers, e.g. `http://localhost:11434` for Ollama. Leave blank to use the provider's own default.

fim.apiKey.markdownDescription:
API key, if the provider needs one. Leave blank for local providers.

Stored in `settings.json` in plaintext and synced by Settings Sync. Machine-scoped, so it cannot be set from a checked-in `.vscode/settings.json`.

fim.contextLength.markdownDescription: Model context length in tokens. Leave unset to use the provider's default.

fim.template.markdownDescription: Override the autodetected FIM prompt template with a Handlebars string using `{{{prefix}}}` and `{{{suffix}}}`. Leave blank to autodetect from the model name.

fim.requestOptions.markdownDescription: Extra HTTP request options: `headers`, `proxy`, `timeout`, `verifySsl`. Edit in `settings.json`.

fim.debounceDelay.description: Milliseconds to wait after a keystroke before requesting a completion.

fim.modelTimeout.markdownDescription: Emergency brake on how long the model may keep generating, in milliseconds (the actual cap is 2.5x this). Measured from the first token, so a slow endpoint is not penalised for its response time. Lower it only if you see completions running on; too low truncates them mid-line.

fim.maxPromptTokens.markdownDescription: Token budget for the whole prompt: the code around the cursor plus any context snippets. Automatically reduced when the model's context length cannot hold this much. Larger budgets give the model more to work with but cost latency.

fim.prefixPercentage.markdownDescription: Share of `#fim.maxPromptTokens#` spent on the code *before* the cursor. The rest is available for the code after it and for context snippets.

fim.maxSuffixPercentage.markdownDescription: Ceiling on the share of `#fim.maxPromptTokens#` spent on the code *after* the cursor. Raise it when working in large files where the code below the cursor matters.

fim.maxCompletionTokens.markdownDescription: Output tokens reserved for the completion itself. Ghost text needs far less than a chat reply; the reservation comes out of the space available for the prompt.

fim.confidenceThreshold.markdownDescription: Suppress suggestions scoring below this for structural soundness, novelty against the code below the cursor, and how well their identifiers are grounded in surrounding code. `0` shows everything. Turn on `#fim.debug#` to see the score for each completion before changing it.

fim.multilineCompletions.description: Whether completions may span multiple lines.

fim.useCache.description: Reuse recent completions for matching prefixes.

fim.onlyMyCode.description: Only draw context snippets from your workspace, not dependencies.

fim.useRecentlyEdited.description: Collect ranges you recently edited, for use as context.

fim.useRecentlyOpened.description: Include recently opened files as context.

fim.useDiagnostics.markdownDescription: Include compiler and linter errors near the cursor in the prompt, so the model can see what is currently broken. Costs a few tokens and usually pays for itself on missing imports.

fim.useImports.description: Include definitions of imported symbols as context.

fim.transform.description: Post-process completions (trim, balance brackets, strip fences).

fim.disableInFiles.description: Glob patterns where autocomplete is disabled.

fim.pauseOnBattery.description: Pause autocomplete while on battery power.

fim.experimental.includeRecentlyVisitedR.description: Include recently visited ranges as context.

fim.experimental.includeRecentlyEditedRa.description: Include the collected recently-edited ranges in the prompt.

fim.experimental.staticContextualization.description: Use tree-sitter/LSP static analysis to gather types and signatures.

fim.debug.markdownDescription: Record every completion to the **FIM Autocomplete** output channel: the prompt sent to the model, which context sources contributed, latency and cache hits. Useful for checking that cross-file context is actually reaching the model. Run **FIM: Show Logs** to open the channel.

fim.showStatsInStatusBar.markdownDescription: Show a running tally on the **FIM** status bar item: completions shown / accepted / acceptance rate / share served from cache. Hover it for latency and completion length. The counts live in memory for this window only and are never sent anywhere; `#fim.debug#` is a separate setting and is not required. The full breakdown, including a per-model split, is available from **FIM: Show Completion Stats**.

fim.showWhateverWeHaveAtXMs.markdownDescription: Once the model has produced its first line, keep streaming for at most this many milliseconds before showing what we have. Bounds how long you wait for a long completion. Raise it if multi-line completions arrive truncated.
